import type { AccessibleMediaContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class AccessibleMedia extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        media: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        captionTracks: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        transcript: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        descriptionTrack: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        signLanguageSource: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        controls: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        autoplay: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        state: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    media: AccessibleMediaContract['media'];
    captionTracks: AccessibleMediaContract['captionTracks'];
    transcript: AccessibleMediaContract['transcript'];
    descriptionTrack: AccessibleMediaContract['descriptionTrack'];
    signLanguageSource: string | undefined;
    controls: boolean;
    autoplay: boolean;
    private state;
    constructor();
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private tracks;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
